title: Mean of Grouped Data — Statistics
hook: Let's explore Mean of Grouped Data from the chapter on Statistics. This is an important concept in NCERT Class 10 Mathematics that builds your foundation for higher studies!
explanation:
Mean of Grouped Data Three methods to find the mean of grouped frequency data: Direct method, Assumed Mean method (shortcut), and Step Deviation method. Key Ideas to Master:
💡 Direct method: Mean = Σfᵢxᵢ / Σfᵢ (where xᵢ = class mark)
💡 Assumed mean: Mean = a + Σfᵢdᵢ/Σfᵢ (dᵢ = xᵢ − a)
💡 Step deviation: Mean = a + (Σfᵢuᵢ/Σfᵢ) × h (uᵢ = dᵢ/h)
💡 Class mark xᵢ = (upper limit + lower limit) / 2
